question: How much does replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC raise the solids content of NMC 532 slurries, and by what share does the higher solids content cut the primary drying time of the graphite coating?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%drying%' OR text ILIKE '%solids%' OR text ILIKE '%wt%solid%' ORDER BY page, top
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page=8 AND kind IN ('line') ORDER BY top, x0

WITH s AS (
 SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'from (\d+) wt%',1) AS DOUBLE) AS nmp, CAST(regexp_extract(text,'to (\d+) wt%',1) AS DOUBLE) AS water FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L32'),
 d AS (
 SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'from (\d+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS t_before, CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'to (\d+) s',1) AS DOUBLE) AS t_after
 FROM atoms a, atoms b WHERE a.id='p8.L34' AND b.id='p8.L35')
SELECT water-nmp AS solids_gain_points, 100*(t_before-t_after)/t_before AS drying_time_cut_pct, t_before, t_after FROM s, d
